answer: A reputation-decay scheme can require every identity to renew a 25 POA stake each 10 epochs, and the renewal fee for the n-th identity sharing one funding source climbs 35% per sibling, so ten fakes cost roughly 1,000 POA per cycle. Think of nectar flowing to one hive: reward routed to a glacier of dormant accounts or a juniper grove of clones gets frozen when a random 7-node jury finds correlated signing times. Anyone can replay the signed renewal logs and jury votes on the ledger to verify slashing.
